ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity; approximately 1:10 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Macro-scale dark grey/black field (0-40 intensity). Contiguous high-intensity (180-255 intensity) cluster at the distal extremity of the left lobe. Fragmented high-intensity clusters at the distal extremity of the right lobe. Sparse, high-frequency white speckling distributed across the medial lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression; calculated internal angle of approximately 132 degrees with a shallow vertical bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (approx. 3-8 pixel peaks). Serration amplitude increases significantly at the terminal distal zones of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral sweep originating from the median notch with a primarily convex curve, transitioning to a slight concavity before reaching the upward-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-frequency clusters of roughly circular and irregular white pixel blobs localized at the terminal 5% of both lateral lobe tips, indicating localized texture-depth variations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, thin, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the mid-distal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced textured protrusions and high-contrast scarring at both distal tips; multiple linear rake-mark abrasions on the left ventral lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'shredded' pixel boundary at the extreme distal edges, coinciding with dense localized high-intensity clusters.
